records.name: Absorb
records.scope: Exact Absorb keyword and explicit native grants; one observed white design.

rationale.W: Primary is my provisional best-fit judgment: the only observed native source is a monowhite common that deliberately grants Absorb. White is therefore the best-supported home in this evidence set. Designer history also places the precursor armor designs in white. This supports a proposed home, not proof of a broad established tier.
rationale.U: No native blue Absorb source was found in the exact-word Scryfall population. Absorbing Man is a substring false positive, not the Absorb keyword. No secondary or tertiary assignment is justified.
rationale.B: No native black Absorb source was found. A black Sliver receiving Absorb from Lymph Sliver is granted access from a white source, not evidence of native black ownership.
rationale.R: No native red Absorb source was found. Receiving the granted ability, copying a card, or lacking observed cards does not establish a red tier.
rationale.G: No native green Absorb source was found. General toughness, resilience, or damage-prevention similarities are not enough to assign this exact keyword a tier.

records.summary: Lymph Sliver supports white as a provisional home. Two printings represent one design.
limitations: One unique card is a very small sample. Two printings do not supply two independent color decisions.
Observed exclusivity supports white as a proposed home but does not prove whether R&D would classify it primary, secondary or tertiary.
Unassigned means not established by this evidence, not unavailable, colorless, zero access or a prohibition.
The classification concerns the exact keyword Absorb, not the counterspell named Absorb, general damage prevention, copying, or all potential recipients of a granted ability.
Absorb being scarce across all Magic does not automatically make it tertiary in its only demonstrated color.
Reassess after a new native design in another color, explicit designer tier guidance, or evidence of a deliberate color-pie exception.
records.label: Scryfall-derived assessment - provisional

rationale.W: Eleven monowhite sources include Angelic Observer, Argivian Phalanx and Pearl-Ear, Imperial Advisor. Repeated native forms and a grant support Secondary across creature and Aura-related applications.
rationale.U: Twenty-four monoblue sources include Thoughtcast, Broodstar and Emry, Lurker of the Loch. This is the largest independent cluster with multiple native spells and grant sources: Primary.
rationale.B: Demonic Junker, Refurbished Familiar and Scales of Shale give three monoblack sources. Numerous joint-color cards do not erase the smaller independent branch; propose Tertiary.
rationale.R: Eleven monored sources, including Chiss-Goria, Furnace Dragon and Oxidda Finisher, establish recurring native/grant access: Secondary. Omniclown adds qualified special-set evidence but does not drive the tier.

limitations: Current saved Oracle text explicitly names Affinity on several older cards once worded as plain cost reduction; use current facts, not historical recollection. Borg Cube is a preview; Thoughtcast has older printings despite a future representative reprint. Colorless designs, special/acorn/playtest sources and the digital Grand Goatnapper are retained without treating them as ordinary colored policy.
